text:
Maria: Heads up — starting pre-PT prep for incident response playbook. Need alignment on RBAC changes, KMS access for assessors, and audit log preservation. Timeline: dry-run Wed 10:00-11:30 PT. Can people confirm owners?

Jon: I can own observability side — log retention snapshots + SIEM exports. Will need read-only access for assessor role mapping.

Ash: I’ll handle RBAC ephemeral roles. Plan: create assessor-role with timebound TTL via our IAM proxy. Need input on required scopes.

Samir: KMS: we should avoid giving raw key decrypt. Instead provide a wrapped artifact or presigned blob. Priya and I can draft the KMS proxy policy.

Priya: Agree. Also confirm we have exports for request-level traces (trace_id + user_id) for the test window.

OpsBot: Reminder: prescheduled maintenance window 03/25 10:00–11:30 added to calendar. /reminder set.

Maria: Quick checklist: 1) RBAC role created and documented. 2) Evidence bucket with WORM enabled. 3) KMS-access pattern for wrapped logs. 4) SIEM parsers for PT events. Assignments?

Jon: I'll do 2+4. I'll upload sample export script: `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-logs/prept-snapshot/ ./ && gzip -c logs > snapshot.gz`

Ash: I'll own 1 — plan to spin up `assessor-temporary` with max TTL 4h. Policies: `ReadLogs`, `ListBuckets`, `GetObject` but deny `PutObject`.

Samir: I'll create draft KMS policy and send to this thread. Also propose using a one-time data key: wrap with our KMS, give assessors the wrapped key.

Priya: We need to capture alerting noise baseline before test. Jon can you run baseline capture for 2 hours pre-window?

Jon: Yes — will start baseline capture Tue 08:00 PT. Pushing expected exports to `s3://redwood-logs/prept-baseline/`

Maria: Retest coordination: we need a sign-off checklist after remediation. Add a PR template for fixes to reference PT ticket + evidence. Who makes final go/no-go call?

Ash: Suggest oncall lead + security lead signoff (that's me + Maria).

Maria: Perfect. I'll create the checklist doc and share link. Anything else?

OpsBot: Oncall rota: @Jon oncall for Wed. React channel: #pt-ops.

Samir: I'll post KMS policy draft by EOD.

Priya: :thumbsup:
